type.zh: 四通道电子断路与配电保护模块
type.en: Four-channel electronic circuit breaker and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-M-402用于12V或24V直流电源下游的四路负载保护与配电，可作为机器人控制柜中控制器、传感器及外围负载的保护选型资料。它不是电池、充电器或机器人功能安全控制器。
overview.en: PISA-M-402 protects and distributes four downstream loads on12V or24V DC supplies, relevant to controller, sensor and auxiliary-load circuits in robot cabinets. It is not a battery, charger or robot functional-safety controller.

overview.zh: 每通道固定2A；仍须遵守该型号总电流、温度与海拔边界，不能直接将四路电流相加作为所有工况输出能力。
overview.en: Each channel has a fixed2A setting. Model total-current, temperature and altitude limits still apply; summing four channels does not establish output capability under every condition.

integration.zh: 核对上游电源峰值供电能力、总电流、通道设定、容性负载和降额；按原厂接线及适用规范设计保护，不将公开参数当作整机安全认证。

verification.zh: 2026年9月数据手册已逐页核对，保存版本、参数条件及型号边界。连续曲线未做像素估值；独立用户手册、完整DCI协议、CAD及证书有效性仍需后续核验。

type.zh: 四通道电子断路与配电保护模块
type.en: Four-channel electronic circuit breaker and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-M-404用于12V或24V直流电源下游的四路负载保护与配电，可作为机器人控制柜中控制器、传感器及外围负载的保护选型资料。它不是电池、充电器或机器人功能安全控制器。
overview.en: PISA-M-404 protects and distributes four downstream loads on12V or24V DC supplies, relevant to controller, sensor and auxiliary-load circuits in robot cabinets. It is not a battery, charger or robot functional-safety controller.

overview.zh: 每通道固定4A；仍须遵守该型号总电流、温度与海拔边界，不能直接将四路电流相加作为所有工况输出能力。
overview.en: Each channel has a fixed4A setting. Model total-current, temperature and altitude limits still apply; summing four channels does not establish output capability under every condition.

applications.en: DC branch protection, sensor supplies and auxiliary distribution in robot cabinets

integration.zh: 核对上游电源峰值供电能力、总电流、通道设定、容性负载和降额；按原厂接线及适用规范设计保护，不将公开参数当作整机安全认证。
integration.en: Check upstream peak supply capability, total current, channel settings, capacitive loads and derating. Design protection from manufacturer wiring and applicable requirements; catalog data does not certify a complete machine.

verification.zh: 2026年9月数据手册已逐页核对，保存版本、参数条件及型号边界。连续曲线未做像素估值；独立用户手册、完整DCI协议、CAD及证书有效性仍需后续核验。
verification.en: September2026 datasheet pages were reviewed with version, conditions and model boundaries retained. Continuous curves were not estimated from pixels; the separate user manual, complete DCI protocol, CAD and certificate validity remain to review.

type.zh: 四通道电子断路与配电保护模块
type.en: Four-channel electronic circuit breaker and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-M-406用于12V或24V直流电源下游的四路负载保护与配电，可作为机器人控制柜中控制器、传感器及外围负载的保护选型资料。它不是电池、充电器或机器人功能安全控制器。
overview.en: PISA-M-406 protects and distributes four downstream loads on12V or24V DC supplies, relevant to controller, sensor and auxiliary-load circuits in robot cabinets. It is not a battery, charger or robot functional-safety controller.

overview.zh: 每通道固定6A；仍须遵守该型号总电流、温度与海拔边界，不能直接将四路电流相加作为所有工况输出能力。
overview.en: Each channel has a fixed6A setting. Model total-current, temperature and altitude limits still apply; summing four channels does not establish output capability under every condition.

applications.en: DC branch protection, sensor supplies and auxiliary distribution in robot cabinets

integration.zh: 核对上游电源峰值供电能力、总电流、通道设定、容性负载和降额；按原厂接线及适用规范设计保护，不将公开参数当作整机安全认证。
integration.en: Check upstream peak supply capability, total current, channel settings, capacitive loads and derating. Design protection from manufacturer wiring and applicable requirements; catalog data does not certify a complete machine.

verification.zh: 2026年9月数据手册已逐页核对，保存版本、参数条件及型号边界。连续曲线未做像素估值；独立用户手册、完整DCI协议、CAD及证书有效性仍需后续核验。
verification.en: September2026 datasheet pages were reviewed with version, conditions and model boundaries retained. Continuous curves were not estimated from pixels; the separate user manual, complete DCI protocol, CAD and certificate validity remain to review.

type.zh: 四通道电子断路与配电保护模块
type.en: Four-channel electronic circuit breaker and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-M-408用于12V或24V直流电源下游的四路负载保护与配电，可作为机器人控制柜中控制器、传感器及外围负载的保护选型资料。它不是电池、充电器或机器人功能安全控制器。
overview.en: PISA-M-408 protects and distributes four downstream loads on12V or24V DC supplies, relevant to controller, sensor and auxiliary-load circuits in robot cabinets. It is not a battery, charger or robot functional-safety controller.

overview.zh: 每通道固定8A；仍须遵守该型号总电流、温度与海拔边界，不能直接将四路电流相加作为所有工况输出能力。
overview.en: Each channel has a fixed8A setting. Model total-current, temperature and altitude limits still apply; summing four channels does not establish output capability under every condition.

type.zh: 四通道电子断路与配电保护模块
type.en: Four-channel electronic circuit breaker and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-M-4ADJ用于12V或24V直流电源下游的四路负载保护与配电，可作为机器人控制柜中控制器、传感器及外围负载的保护选型资料。它不是电池、充电器或机器人功能安全控制器。
overview.en: PISA-M-4ADJ protects and distributes four downstream loads on12V or24V DC supplies, relevant to controller, sensor and auxiliary-load circuits in robot cabinets. It is not a battery, charger or robot functional-safety controller.

overview.zh: 每通道可选1、2、3、4、6、8A，模块总电流最大20A；离散设定与总电流限制需要同时满足。
overview.en: Each channel selects1,2,3,4,6 or8A, subject to a20A combined-output maximum. Discrete settings and total-current limits apply together.

type.zh: 四通道电子断路与配电保护模块
type.en: Four-channel electronic circuit breaker and distribution protection

overview.zh: PISA-M-4CL2用于12V或24V直流电源下游的四路负载保护与配电，可作为机器人控制柜中控制器、传感器及外围负载的保护选型资料。它不是电池、充电器或机器人功能安全控制器。
overview.en: PISA-M-4CL2 protects and distributes four downstream loads on12V or24V DC supplies, relevant to controller, sensor and auxiliary-load circuits in robot cabinets. It is not a battery, charger or robot functional-safety controller.

overview.zh: 各通道跳闸电流随输入电压变化：24V时3.75A、12V时4.85A，按NEC Class2口径限制；不能套用可调版本1–8A设定。
overview.en: Channel tripping current varies with supply voltage:3.75A at24V and4.85A at12V, within the NEC Class2 scope. The adjustable-model1–8A settings do not apply.
